description: Peruviano Inca — Colore: White, tan & black Codice: 5089 Materiale: 100% Cotton Scala: Medium Altezza: 143 cm Rapporto: 69 cm × 65.5 cm Toni: Black, Brown The curvilinear design of PERUVIANO honors the traditional knowledge and daily lives of the early Peruvian people, where textile design was central to the lives and identity of many of the culture’s women. PERUVIANO’s expressive design represents agricultural tools (seen in the “s” shape motif), zoomorphic figures reminiscent of the Nazca lines in Peru, and even the art of weaving itself.
